execute.rationale: Governed. Executes arbitrary JavaScript against the authenticated Fastly API surface, including irreversible deletion, purge, security, and service-configuration operations; the generic tool name understates its maximum impact.

inspect.rationale: Pass-through. Reads bundled API method documentation and does not invoke an authenticated Fastly API operation.

search.rationale: Pass-through. Searches the MCP server's bundled API method index and does not invoke an authenticated Fastly API operation.
